the joint resistance is a good indicator to evaluate the quality of the joints, but the joint resistance alone is not enough to evaluate the joint quality, because the joint resistance depends on the joint structure and the joint quality is determined by the joint resistance and the joint voltage distribution among voltage taps.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the joint resistance of a full-size joint can be measured with a short conductor sample.
a joint resistance of less than 3-nΩ is achievable by a joint box of 1.5-m long.
the joint resistance can be estimated by the increase of the voltage drop among the voltage taps, and the joint resistance is not affected by the voltage taps.
